migration: This v3 lock retains the complete agent_route/v1 role and risk baseline, adds sparse deterministic agent_route/v2 task-family overrides, and retains observed agent_trace compatibility for older locks.
taskAwareRouting: A v2 key is agent_route/v2|<task-family>|<role>|<risk>. An exact v2 override wins; an unlisted task cell falls back to the matching v1 role baseline. Task-specific cells are compiler-owned experiments until settled evaluation evidence promotes them.
taskEvidenceBoundary: Shell, file, and tool dispatch remain bounded action/role evidence. They do not create a task family or select a task-specific route.
toolPolicy: All three tiers are tool-safe; supplied tools do not clamp the selected predictive route.
strongMutationObservation: A strong-model mutation that differs from the predicted action is recorded as a descriptive mismatch, never as an automatic quality verdict.
